name: Public Records
status_note: Open. The official site lists current campus hours and events, with no closure notice. Songkick and JamBase list Oct 2026 shows (Oct 9, Oct 24). It's a multi-space campus: the Atrium restaurant, the Sound Room (live music and club, ~200 capacity), UPSTAIRS listening bar, Cafe Public and the open-air Nursery. Commercial Observer has a headline on a new Public Records live venue in Sunset Park; no details or opening date were verified.

dress.detail: The official site and the reviews checked (The Infatuation, Xceed) mention no dress code.

cover.value: The restaurant, cafe and bar charge no entry fee. Sound Room shows and club nights are ticketed on DICE, e.g. a jazz show on Oct 24, 2026 from ~$32.

sources.name: Public Records official site (DICE ticket links)

getting_in.value: Book Atrium and UPSTAIRS tables on Resy. Buy Sound Room and Nursery event tickets on DICE (a few events go through partner pages).

hours.value: Campus hours: Wed-Thu 6-10pm, Fri 6pm-4am, Sat 10am-4am, Sun 10am-9pm; closed Mon-Tue. Event times vary.

subway.value: Union St (R) is the likely nearest stop, a short walk; Carroll St (F/G) is also nearby. No source confirmed this.

skip_if: You want spontaneous late-night dancing: the club nights are ticketed and the Sound Room holds only ~200.
You want a dressy cocktail-bar night: it's a casual, music-first, mostly vegan-food campus.
